span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Infragranular somatostatin interneurons serve as a transient intermediate relay carrying thalamic activity to parvalbumin interneurons and pyramidal cells before those cells are directly innervated by the thalamus
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Spontaneous GABA released from somatostatin interneurons tonically activates parvalbumin interneurons, which drives the development of their thalamocortical synapses
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Somatostatin interneurons hold thalamocortical afferents as a postsynaptic placeholder, supplying trophic support that later allows those afferents to target parvalbumin interneurons
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: SST interneurons act as an intermediate relay for TC afferent outputs to PV interneurons and PNs, prior to when TC afferents target these latter populations

span.label: the loss of thalamic drive is only partly explained by a smaller unitary current, and the rest by a fall in the number of thalamic terminals counted as Vglut2 puncta

span.label: spontaneous vesicular GABA diffusion, and not evoked synaptic transmission, is what parvalbumin interneurons need from them

span.label: or alternatively the somatostatin interneurons act as a postsynaptic placeholder holding thalamic fibers until parvalbumin synapses can be established
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The specific role played by somatostatin interneuron synaptic output in driving parvalbumin interneuron maturation is not resolved by the experiments reported.
span.note: what this limits: the mechanism, not the requirement: the need for SST cells is demonstrated, but UNDERSTANDING THE PRECISE ROLE OF THEIR SYNAPTIC OUTPUTS IN THIS PROCESS WILL REQUIRE FURTHER INVESTIGATION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The findings come from layer 5/6 somatostatin interneurons and may not generalise across the heterogeneous somatostatin population in other layers.
span.note: what this limits: any generalisation from these cells to somatostatin interneurons as a class: THE POSSIBILITY THAT ALL SST INTERNEURONS ARE ALL EQUIVALENT SHOULD BE CONSIDERED WITH CAUTION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The molecular mechanism that prunes the transient thalamocortical input onto somatostatin interneurons is unknown.
span.note: what this limits: the pruning result: it is observed, but THE MOLECULAR AND CELLULAR SIGNALS THAT REGULATE PRUNING REMAIN TO BE DETERMINED
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the genetic driver is not restricted to somatostatin interneurons, with a fidelity of about 86% in L5 and 83% in L6
span.note: what this limits: what the label means throughout: recombination WAS NOT COMPLETELY RESTRICTED TO SST INTERNEURONS - THE FIDELITY WAS QUITE HIGH: ~86% IN L5 AND 83% L6

span.label: the two ages could not be traced with the same reagent, because rabies glycoprotein from the Rosa locus stops supporting transfer after P10

span.label: the signals that drive the pruning are unknown, and neither release probability nor receptor composition accounts for the change

span.label: the impact of GABA released from these cells in the immature brain is not understood, and the source of GABA in the developing cortex is still unknown

'To our surprise, despite their common embryonic origin and immunohistochemical properties, the earliest born SST interneur[ONS] [differ].' 'the spontaneous vesicular GABA diffusion into the extracellular space, but not evoked synaptic transmission from SST interneurons is required for the synaptic development of PV interneurons.' The developmental signal is carried by the mode of release nobody manipulates deliberately - so an experiment that blocks evoked transmission leaves the effective signal intact and concludes the cells are not involved. · strength of the relation: 1 · note: A DISSOCIATION BUILT FROM TWO MANIPULATIONS OF ONE PATHWAY: blocking evoked vesicular release changes nothing, reducing presynaptic GABA reproduces the phenotype 2026-08-20 the project re-read worst chars/edge queue): VAGUE-ENDPOINTS - the contrast IS the passage's conclusion - 'spontaneous vesicular…' - but the endpoints are two bare adjectives.
